verdict.rationale: Sentry's Trace Explorer documents aggregating data by span attributes with flexible queries and filters, and the Issues page allows filtering by properties such as impacted users. That points to ad-hoc grouping and filtering on raw telemetry, but nothing says it works on high-cardinality fields like user or request IDs without pre-aggregation or index setup. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of high-cardinality group-by on user id or request id, documentation that no pre-aggregation or index definition is needed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first

citations.quote: You can now explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and aggregate your data with flexible queries and filters.
This page allows you to filter by properties such as browser, device, impacted users, or whether an error is unhandled.
